items.statement: Record quarter: PAT +145% to Rs 5,469 cr, revenue +77% to Rs 13,747 cr; op margin 52% (from 38%); zinc CoP at a record-low $851/t; mined metal 268 KT.
items.quote: Hindustan Zinc — Q1 FY27 (results 24 Jul 2026; Rs 11 dividend) An exceptional print — record profit and EBITDA, powered by strong metal prices, record-low costs and higher volumes. The cost line is the standout. Numbers. Net profit Rs 5,469 cr (+145% YoY); revenue Rs 13,747 cr (+77% YoY). Operating margin 52% (from 38%) . Interim dividend Rs 11/share. Operating KPIs (metals). Highest-ever Q1 mined

items.statement: Mined metal production reached a record first-quarter high of 268 KT due to improved mined grades.
items.quote: Highest-ever first-quarter mined metal production of 268 KT for the fifth consecutive year, driven by better mined grades

items.statement: Refined metal production increased by 4% year-over-year, aided by capacity unlocked through debottlenecking at Chanderiya and Dariba.
items.quote: Refined metal production at 260 KT, up 4% YoY, supported by capacity unlocked through debottlenecking initiatives at Chanderiya & Dariba

items.statement: The company experienced cost pressures from reduced domestic coal usage and higher input commodity prices due to global geopolitical issues.
items.quote: partly offset by lower domestic coal usage and increased input commodities prices in line with the ongoing geopolitical crisis globally

items.statement: Zinc and lead prices are expected to remain resilient despite some market surplus.
items.quote: Zinc & Lead prices are forecasted to stay resilient despite some surplus

items.statement: Hindustan Zinc is well-positioned to benefit from the global rise in silver prices.
items.quote: As silver shines globally, Hindustan Zinc is uniquely positioned to capture the upcycle

items.statement: The company plans to expand its refined metal capacity at Debari to 1,379 KTPA and mined metal capacity across mines to 1,510 KTPA.
items.quote: Refined metal capacity expansion: 1,129 KTPA to 1,379 KTPA at Debari Mined metal capacity expansion: 1,180 KTPA to 1,510 KTPA across mines

items.statement: The company is progressing with a tailings reprocessing plant with a 10 MTPA feed capacity and an approved investment of 3,823 crore rupees.
items.quote: Transforming waste into valuable resources while contributing significantly to circular economy Feed capacity: 10 MTPA Total approved investment: ₹ 3,823 crore Target completion: 4QFY28

items.statement: Domestic zinc demand is growing as India's steel production capacity is projected to reach 300 MTPA by 2030.
items.quote: Domestic zinc demand strengthens as domestic steel production capacity expands to 300 MTPA by 2030

items.statement: Structural demand for silver is accelerating due to the global energy transition, industrial applications, and investor interest.
items.quote: Global energy transition, increased Industrial use mainly in solar panels, electric vehicles, electronics etc and investors demand accelerates silver demand structurally

items.statement: Zinc prices reached a peak of $3,625 per tonne during the quarter, while lead prices stayed relatively stable.
items.quote: In a volatile global economic scenario, zinc prices peaked at $3,625/MT while lead prices remained broadly stable during the quarter

items.statement: Silver prices experienced volatility during the quarter, driven by safe-haven demand, market deficits, and higher industrial and investment usage.
items.quote: Silver prices remained volatile during the quarter, supported by continued safe-haven demand, market deficit, and improved industrial use and investments

items.statement: The company achieved its lowest quarterly cost of production of $851 per tonne, supported by better grades, higher production, and renewable power.
items.quote: Lowest quarterly COP* of $851 per tonne, driven by better mined grades, increased metal production, better renewable power consumption and higher by-product realisations

items.statement: Cost performance was partially impacted by reduced domestic coal usage and rising input commodity prices from geopolitical tensions.
items.quote: partly offset by lower domestic coal usage and increased input commodities prices in line with the ongoing geopolitical crisis globally

items.statement: The company maintains a dominant domestic primary zinc market share of approximately 74% alongside a consistent EBITDA margin of around 54%.
items.quote: c.74% domestic primary zinc market share with a consistent c.54% EBITDA margin

items.statement: The company achieved an industry-leading EBITDA margin of 59% during the quarter, up about 900 basis points year-over-year.
items.quote: Industry Leading EBITDA Margin 59% Up c.900 bps YoY Up c.150 bps QoQ

items.statement: The company has approved an investment of 3,823 crore rupees for its first zinc tailings reprocessing plant, scheduled for completion by Q4 FY28.
items.quote: Transforming waste into valuable resources while contributing significantly to circular economy Feed capacity: 10 MTPA Total approved investment: ₹ 3,823 crore Target completion: 4QFY28

items.statement: The company is expanding its refined metal capacity at Debari to 1,379 KTPA and mined metal capacity across mines to 1,510 KTPA.
items.quote: Refined metal capacity expansion: 1,129 KTPA to 1,379 KTPA at Debari Mined metal capacity expansion: 1,180 KTPA to 1,510 KTPA across mines

items.statement: The company is implementing technology at Dariba to recover silver and lead from smelting waste, with the potential to produce 27 TPA of silver and 6 KTPA of lead annually.
items.quote: Implementing an innovative technology for recovery of silver and lead from the smelting waste – jarosite at Dariba Potential to produce 27 TPA silver and 6 KTPA lead annually

items.statement: Major supply orders have been placed and construction has started, with site mobilization for infrastructure development finished.
items.quote: Major supply orders placed and construction commenced Site mobilization for infrastructure development completed

items.statement: The company maintains a robust financial profile and strong balance sheet, supported by an AAA investment grade credit rating.
items.quote: Robust financial profile and strong balance sheet Financial resilience through the cycle AAA investment grade credit rating

items.statement: The company aims to lead India's critical minerals sector through diversification, systematic exploration, and sustainable resource development.
items.quote: Poised to lead India's critical minerals ecosystem through diversification, systematic exploration, and sustainable resource development

items.statement: The company signed agreements with Advantek Associates and Aero Eagle Automobiles to adopt green hydrogen and other clean energy solutions.
items.quote: MoUs with Advantek Associates LLP & Aero Eagle Automobiles Pvt Ltd for adoption of green Hydrogen & other clean energy solutions

items.statement: The global energy transition and rising industrial applications in solar panels and electric vehicles are structurally accelerating silver demand.
items.quote: Global energy transition, increased Industrial use mainly in solar panels, electric vehicles, electronics etc and investors demand accelerates silver demand structurally

items.statement: Domestic zinc demand is strengthening in tandem with the expansion of India's steel production capacity to 300 MTPA by 2030.
items.quote: Domestic zinc demand strengthens as domestic steel production capacity expands to 300 MTPA by 2030

items.statement: The company faces uncertainties from financial and metals markets, including fluctuations in interest rates, exchange rates, and metal prices.
items.quote: For us, uncertainties arise from the behaviour of financial and metals markets including the London Metal Exchange, fluctuations in interest and or exchange rates and metal prices

items.statement: positive
items.quote: India’s economic outlook remains strong, supported by upbeat consumer sentiment & robust demand

items.statement: The company posted record quarterly EBITDA of INR 8,074 crores and all-time high net profit of INR 5,469 crores.
items.quote: During the quarter, we reported highest ever EBITDA of INR8,074 crores, resulting into a record net profit of INR5,469 crores, making a new milestone for the company.

items.statement: Power and fuel expenses increased sequentially because of reduced domestic linkage coal materialization and the use of costlier imported coal.
items.quote: So the power and fuel cost during the quarter has dincreased majorly due to our materialization of linkage coal, which is slightly lower due to the various reasons, including the mine conditions from where we take coal.

items.statement: Silver prices softened quarter-on-quarter to USD 73 per troy ounce due to macroeconomic factors and investor positioning.
items.quote: Silver prices moderated during the quarter to USD73 per troy ounce compared with the strong levels seen in the previous quarter, reflecting broader macroeconomic and investor positioning factors.

items.statement: Management expects medium-term silver fundamentals to remain constructive due to energy transition demand and limited global supply growth.
items.quote: While near-term price movements may remain volatile, the medium-term outlook continues to be constructive, driven by structural demand from the energy transition and relatively constrained global supply growth.

items.statement: The long-term outlook for key metals remains positive despite short-term sensitivity to global macroeconomic events.
items.quote: While commodity market may remain sensitive to global developments in the near term, the long-term outlook for our key metals remains positive.

items.statement: Management guided full-year growth project capex at USD 500 million to USD 600 million.
items.quote: So the guidance for the year is on the growth project is around USD500 million to USD600 million we are expecting. And during the quarter, we have spent around INR800 crores.

items.statement: Zinc cost of production remained within the guided range of USD 975 to USD 1,000 per tonne before factoring in higher byproduct credits.
items.quote: So during the quarter, our COP is broadly in line with the guidance we have given, which is 975 to 1,000, and the additional benefit is because of the by-product realization, which is higher than this.

items.statement: Base metal demand remained steady from infrastructure, galvanizing, and battery sectors amid constrained mine supply.
items.quote: Market fundamentals remained broadly supportive, underpinned by constrained mine supply and steady demand from infrastructure, galvanization and battery applications.

items.statement: Silver demand is seeing structural growth driven by adoption in solar, electronics, and energy transition applications.
items.quote: Silver is benefiting from accelerated adoption across solar, electronics and other energy transition applications, creating a strong structural demand outlook.

items.statement: During the quarter, zinc averaged USD 3,466 per tonne and lead averaged USD 1,954 per tonne.
items.quote: Zinc averaged USD3,466 per ton, reaching a high of USD3,625 per ton, while lead averaged USD1,954 per ton.

items.statement: Zinc cost of production excluding royalty fell 16% year-on-year to USD 851 per tonne.
items.quote: On the cost front, despite the volatile geopolitical environment, we achieved the lowest quarterly zinc cost of production, excluding royalty, since underground transition to USD851 per ton, reflecting a decline of 16% year-on-year.

items.statement: Mine development has begun to support the upcoming 250 KTPA integrated zinc smelter at Debari.
items.quote: For the 250 KTPA integrated zinc smelter at Debari, mine development activities have started for matching the mining capacity.

items.statement: The hot acid leaching plant at Dariba and the fertilizer plant at Chanderiya remain scheduled for completion in the second quarter.
items.quote: Our other 2 key projects, that is hot acid leaching plant at Dariba and fertilizer plant at Chanderiya are on track to be completed by the second quarter of the year.

items.statement: Construction has started on the tailings recycling plant, which is projected to take 24 months and yield 30,000 to 35,000 tonnes of zinc.
items.quote: For tailing recycling, we have just started the construction. So it will be another 24 months before the facility can be constructed. And we expect about 30, 35 kt of zinc to be produced out of that.

items.statement: Hindustan Zinc closed the quarter with a net cash position of INR 5,572 crores.
items.quote: We ended this quarter with a net cash position of INR5,572 crores, providing significant financial flexibility to pursue value-accretive growth opportunities while maintaining an attractive shareholder return profile.

items.statement: The company entered agreements with Advantek Associates and Aero Eagle Automobile to foster green hydrogen and clean energy usage.
items.quote: We also signed MOUs with Advantek Associates LLP and Aero Eagle Automobile Pvt Ltd to advance the adoption of green hydrogen and other clean energy solutions.

items.statement: Base metal markets operated under conditions of geopolitical friction and shifting trade dynamics.
items.quote: Against a backdrop of geopolitical uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics, base metal markets remained relatively resilient during the quarter.

items.statement: positive
items.quote: As demand for zinc, silver and critical minerals continue to be supported by global megatrends, we believe Hindustan Zinc is going to deliver sustainable growth, resilient cash flows and long-term value creation for our shareholders.
